name: Thrasios
description: A triton of Meletis who believes he has Thassa's blessing and pilgrimages to the ocean's depths, claiming to have visited Olantin.

timeline.summary: Thrasios leaves Meletis on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths.
timeline.quote: Thrasios has left his home and embarked on a pilgrimage to explore the ocean's depths at the edge of the world.

relations.note: He believes he has her divine sanction.
relations.quote: Believing he possesses the divine sanction of Thassa, god of the sea

pages_say.description: A triton of Meletis who believes he has Thassa's blessing and pilgrimages to the ocean's depths, claiming to have visited Olantin.
